step: Appium connects to the phone
expected_result: Session starts; phone screen is unlocked

step: Check the doctor app (Marham Connect) is installed
expected_result: com.ts.marham_connect is installed

step: Read the doctor app version
expected_result: Version is written in the report and matches DOCTOR_EXPECTED_APP_VERSION

step: Open the doctor app
expected_result: Home ('Overview') or the login screen opens

step: Check who is logged in
expected_result: The test doctor (DOCTOR_APP_NAME) is logged in; any other doctor = run stops

step: Profile tab > Log Out
expected_result: 'Enter your mobile number' opens (no confirmation asked)

step: Tap Login with Email
expected_result: 'Welcome back' opens with Email, Password and Login

step: Tap Login with both boxes empty
expected_result: Not logged in; still on 'Welcome back'

step: Enter the email and a wrong password (WRONG_PASSWORD); tap Login
expected_result: Not logged in; still on 'Welcome back'; the app's message is saved in the report

step: Enter the real password (typed by the tester); tap Login
expected_result: Home ('Overview') opens with the test doctor's name

step: Close and reopen the app
expected_result: Still logged in as the test doctor

step: Open the Appointments tab
expected_result: Title 'Appointments', tabs Upcoming / Completed / Others and the 'Showing ...' date range are shown

step: Upcoming tab: read every card (scrolling)
expected_result: Each card has status, patient, date, time and location; number of cards = the number on the Upcoming tab

step: Check the buttons on SCHEDULED cards (nothing tapped)
expected_result: All: View Detail (+ Chat on video). On the appointment day also: Start Session (video) or Showed Up, Not Showed Up (clinic)

step: Tap View Detail on a scheduled video appointment
expected_result: 'Appointment Details' shows the same patient, status, date, time and type, plus Start Session, Chat with Patient, Mark Showed Up, Mark Not Showed Up, Previous Prescriptions, Contact patient

step: Scroll down on Appointment Details
expected_result: 'Payment Details' is shown with its values (saved in the report)

step: Go back
expected_result: Appointments list with its tabs is shown again

step: Open the Completed and Others tabs
expected_result: Each shows complete cards or 'No appointments found'

step: Make a new booking from the patient app (13-b Hospital, Pay at Clinic / Video Consultation, paid from Marham Wallet; Self or a family member) or use one already waiting in Pending Confirmations
expected_result: New booking: card fee matches Manage Locations; pop-up shows doctor, patient and time; Request Received screen shows the booking with Pending Confirmation (video: Rs. fee and Paid)

step: Patient app: find the booking in Bookings
expected_result: Card shows AWAITING CONFIRMATION and 'Waiting for doctor confirmation.'

step: Doctor app: open Pending Confirmations from the Home tile
expected_result: Tile count = number of cards; the new booking is listed with Accept and Reschedule

step: Tap Accept on the new booking only
expected_result: 'Appointment confirmed successfully' shown; card leaves the list, also after a restart; tile count goes down by 1

step: Doctor app: Appointments > Upcoming
expected_result: The booking is SCHEDULED with the same date and time at 13-b Hospital

step: Patient app: Bookings again
expected_result: Card shows SCHEDULED, PAY AT CLINIC; no 'Waiting for doctor confirmation'

step: Open the Profile tab
expected_result: Test doctor's name, specialty, Verified Profile, experience and rating; all rows (View Profile ... Help & Support, Log Out) and the 4 section titles

step: Open View Profile
expected_result: Full Name, Email, Phone, PMDC, Specialization, Years of Experience filled and read-only; match the Profile tab

step: Open Manage Locations
expected_result: Exactly Video Consultation (Video, PKR 2) and 13-b Hospital (In-Person, PKR 100), each with an address

step: Open Edit Location for each location (nothing saved)
expected_result: Hospital Details shows the same name and fee; at least one slot ON with days and Start < End

step: Open Scheduler Settings and show each location (nothing saved)
expected_result: One location option selected; slot length = 10 min (video) and 5 min (13-b Hospital)

step: Open Manage Leaves
expected_result: Leaves (or 'No leaves scheduled') are recorded in the report

step: Patient app: Booking Summary of each location, today and tomorrow (nothing booked)
expected_result: Slots only on working days, inside the hours, on the slot-length grid and spaced by it; none less than 15 min after now; tomorrow starts at the start time

step: Scheduler Settings > Video Consultation: change 10 min to 15 min, Save
expected_result: 'Scheduler settings updated'; reopened screen shows 15 min

step: Patient app: Video Consultation Booking Summary for tomorrow
expected_result: Slots are 15 minutes apart

step: Hospital Details (Video Consultation): switch the day after tomorrow OFF, Save
expected_result: The day chip is OFF and saved

step: Patient app: Video Consultation Booking Summary
expected_result: That day has no date chip and no slots

step: Clean-up (always): day back ON and slot length back to 10 min
expected_result: Both saved (otherwise reports\MANUAL_CLEANUP_NEEDED.txt)

step: Patient app after the clean-up
expected_result: The day has slots again and slots are 10 minutes apart

step: Doctor app > Profile > Manage Leaves: look for a leave on the day after tomorrow
expected_result: No leave on that day (else the test stops and changes nothing)

step: Patient app: Booking Summary of Video Consultation and 13-b Hospital
expected_result: Both offer the day after tomorrow (date chip + slots)

step: Add New Leave: All Locations; Start and End Date = that day (date picker + OK); Reason 'Automation test leave'; Save Leave
expected_result: Both dates show 'Oct 25 2026' style; 'Leave created successfully'

step: Manage Leaves (reopened)
expected_result: One card per location (Video Consultation + 13-b Hospital); date range = that day; Reason = the typed reason

step: Patient app: Video Consultation Booking Summary
expected_result: No date chip / slots on the leave day; tomorrow still offered

step: Patient app: 13-b Hospital Booking Summary
expected_result: No date chip / slots on the leave day; tomorrow still offered

step: Clean-up (always): bin on each leave card of that day > Delete Leave dialog > DELETE
expected_result: 'Leave deleted successfully' each time; no leave left on that day (else reports/MANUAL_CLEANUP_NEEDED.txt)

step: Patient app: both Booking Summaries again
expected_result: The leave day is offered again

step: No leave on that day; patient 13-b offers it; Add New Leave for 13-b Hospital only and Save Leave
expected_result: 'Leave created successfully'

step: Manage Leaves (reopened)
expected_result: Exactly one card for that day: 13-b Hospital

step: Patient app: 13-b Hospital Booking Summary
expected_result: No date chip / slots on the leave day; tomorrow still offered

step: Patient app: Video Consultation Booking Summary
expected_result: The leave day is STILL offered (leave was only for 13-b)

step: Clean-up (always): delete the 13-b leave card
expected_result: 'Leave deleted successfully'; no leave left on that day

step: Patient app: 13-b Hospital Booking Summary
expected_result: The leave day is offered again

step: Doctor app > Appointments: first card with a Chat button (Upcoming then Completed) > Chat
expected_result: Chat opens (patient name at the top; 'Enter message' box)

step: Doctor types 'AT doctor <time>' and taps SEND
expected_result: Message box is empty again; message is the newest one on the RIGHT with the right time

step: Open the phone's notifications
expected_result: 'Dr. Momina Testing has sent you a message' arrives within 20 s

step: Patient app > Bookings > SCHEDULED card of the test doctor > chat icon
expected_result: The doctor's message is shown on the LEFT (received) within 60 s

step: Patient types 'AT patient <time>' and taps SEND
expected_result: Newest message on the RIGHT with the right time; below the doctor's message

step: Doctor app (fresh start) > Chat again
expected_result: The patient's message is on the LEFT below the doctor's own message (on the right)

step: Patient app (fresh start) > chat again
expected_result: Both messages are still there: doctor's on the left then own on the right

step: Put a test picture 'AT_chat_<time>.png' in the phone's Download folder
expected_result: The file is on the phone

step: Doctor app chat: '+' > Files > the test picture
expected_result: Back in the chat; the picture is the newest message on the RIGHT with the right time

step: Patient app chat (SCHEDULED booking > Chat with doctor)
expected_result: The doctor's picture is the newest message on the LEFT with the right time

step: Patient: mic > RECORD > about 4 s > SEND
expected_result: Panel starts at 00:00 with SEND disabled; voice note is the newest message on the RIGHT; its length = the timer shown

step: Doctor app chat (fresh start)
expected_result: The voice note is the newest message on the LEFT with the same length; own picture still on the right

step: Clean-up (always): delete the test picture from the phone's Download folder
expected_result: The file is gone
